nodes.description: Mapping of token balances by address; written in transfer, transferFrom and the IOVOToken constructor.
Total token supply storage variable, exposed by totalSupply() and initialized in the constructor.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount managed by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Constant token supply 1000000000 * 10**18 assigned to totalSupply_ during deployment.
Public token name string 'IOVO Token'.
Public token symbol string 'IOVO'.
Public token decimals value 18.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath integer division, truncating the quotient.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow assertion.
SafeMath addition with overflow assertion.
View function returning totalSupply_.
ERC20 transfer that decrements sender balance and increments recipient balance.
View function returning the balance of a given address.
ERC20 transferFrom that moves balances using the caller allowance.
Sets the allowance of a spender to msg.sender, enabling the known approve race condition.
View function returning the remaining allowance for owner/spender.
Atomically increases the caller allowance for a spender.
Atomically decreases the caller allowance, resetting to zero when the subtracted value exceeds the old value.
Deployment constructor minting INITIAL_SUPPLY to tx.origin.
Attacker-controlled caller address used as the owner of balances and allowances.
Transaction origin used as the recipient of the whole initial token supply.
balances[tx.origin] = INITIAL_SUPPLY; ownership is granted based on tx.origin instead of msg.sender.
uint256 c = a * b; raw multiplication guarded only by a later assert, executed before validation.
balances[_from] = balances[_from].sub(_value); privileged debit of an arbitrary account allowed by spender allowance.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; direct allowance overwrite enabling the approve front-running race.
balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(_value); sender balance decrement followed by a state write.
_to address parameter of transfer().
_value amount parameter of transfer().
_owner address parameter of balanceOf().
_from source address parameter of transferFrom().
_to destination address parameter of transferFrom().
_value amount parameter of transferFrom().
_spender address parameter of approve().
_value allowance amount parameter of approve().
_owner address parameter of allowance().
_spender address parameter of allowance().
_spender address parameter of increaseApproval().
_addedValue amount parameter of increaseApproval().
_spender address parameter of decreaseApproval().
_subtractedValue amount parameter of decreaseApproval().
First uint256 operand a of SafeMath.mul().
Second uint256 operand b of SafeMath.mul().
Local product c = a * b inside SafeMath.mul().
Local quotient c = a / b inside SafeMath.div().
Local oldValue snapshot of the current allowance inside decreaseApproval().

edges.reason: msg.sender determines whose balance is debited in transfer().
msg.sender allowance is consumed by transferFrom().
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve().
msg.sender allowance is incremented in increaseApproval().
msg.sender allowance is decremented in decreaseApproval().
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping that is overwritten.
tx.origin is passed into the constructor logic as the supply owner.
tx.origin directly determines the recipient of INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constructor executes the balances[tx.origin] assignment.
Constructor initializes the balances mapping at deployment.
Constructor stores INITIAL_SUPPLY into totalSupply_.
INITIAL_SUPPLY is read to mint the entire supply.
totalSupply() returns the totalSupply_ state variable.
totalSupply() reads totalSupply_ storage.
transfer() reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
transferFrom() reads and writes the allowed mapping.
approve() writes the allowed mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval() reads and writes the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval() reads and writes the allowed mapping.
_to parameter is the credited recipient in transfer().
_value parameter is the transferred amount in transfer().
_value is subtracted from the sender balance.
transfer() performs the balance subtraction state write.
transfer() calls SafeMath.sub with _value.
transfer() calls SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
_owner parameter selects the queried balance entry.
_from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom().
_to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom().
_value parameter is the moved amount in transferFrom().
_value is subtracted from balances[_from].
transferFrom() executes the balance debit state write.
transferFrom() calls SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom() calls SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
_spender parameter receives the allowance in approve().
_value parameter is the allowance amount in approve().
_value is written directly into the allowance mapping.
approve() overwrites the allowance without a zero-first check.
_owner parameter of allowance().
_spender parameter of allowance().
_spender parameter of increaseApproval().
_addedValue is added to the existing allowance.
increaseApproval() calls SafeMath.add on the allowance.
_spender parameter of decreaseApproval().
_subtractedValue is compared with and subtracted from the allowance.
_subtractedValue is compared against the oldValue snapshot.
decreaseApproval() calls SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
Operand a flows into SafeMath.mul().
Operand b flows into SafeMath.mul().
Operand a participates in the unchecked product a * b.
Operand b participates in the unchecked product a * b.
Local c receives the overflow-prone multiplication result.
SafeMath.mul() performs uint256 c = a * b before the assert.
Local c is the quotient returned by SafeMath.div().

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a value passed directly into transfer() and carries no independent identity.
_value only parameterizes the balance update inside transfer().
_owner is only used to index balances inside balanceOf().
_from only parameterizes the debited account of transferFrom().
_to only parameterizes the credited account of transferFrom().
_value only parameterizes the amount moved by transferFrom().
_spender only identifies the allowance entry written by approve().
_value is the raw allowance written by approve().
_owner only indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
_spender only indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
_spender only selects the allowance entry updated by increaseApproval().
_addedValue is consumed directly by the SafeMath.add allowance update.
_spender only selects the allowance entry updated by decreaseApproval().
_subtractedValue is consumed directly by decreaseApproval's comparison and subtraction.
Operand a exists only as an input to the multiplication in SafeMath.mul().
Operand b exists only as an input to the multiplication in SafeMath.mul().
Local c is the intermediate result of the overflow-prone a * b operation.
Local c is the transient quotient computed inside SafeMath.div().
oldValue is a temporary snapshot of the allowance read inside decreaseApproval().
